title.zh: 将奎松市 Cubao 中学的 Murphy 附属校更名为 Juan Sumulong 中学，并为其拨付经费的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Cubao High School, Murphy Annex, in Quezon City to Juan Sumulong High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Cubao High School, Murphy Annex, in Quezon City to Juan Sumulong High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5120_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All persons appointed to positions of provincial fiscals, assistant provincial fiscals, city fiscals and assistant city fiscals created after June twenty, nineteen hundred and sixty-four shall be entitled to receive salaries in accordance with the rates as provided in Republic Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and forty-two.

Unless the laws creating the positions provide otherwise, the salaries of the provincial fiscals and city fiscals and their assistants referred to in Section one of this Act will continue to be paid by their respective provinces and cities based on the salary rates fixed in Republic Acts Numbered Seventeen hundred and ninety-nine and Eighteen hundred and thirty-six and by the provisions of the charters of the said cities, and the difference between these salaries and those provided for in Republic Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and forty-two shall be paid out of national funds.
This Act shall not apply to the City of Manila and Quezon City.
Such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 17, 1967.
